verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਵਤ ਪੈ ਸੁਪਨ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਦੇਖੀਓ ਚਾਹੇ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਉਨਮਨੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sovat pai supan charitr chitr dhekheeo chaahe sahaj samaadh bikhai unamanee jot hai ||

en.bdb: If someone desires to see the happenings of a dream in reality, it is not possible. Similarly the divine radiance of the celestial light generated due to Naam Simran cannot be described.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਾਪਾਨ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਮਤਵਾਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਜਿਉ ਨਿਝਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਅਨਭੈ ਉਦੋਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: suraapaan savaiaadh matavaaraa prat prasa(n)n jiau nijhar apaar dhaar anabhai udhot hai ||

en.bdb: As a drunkard feels satisfied and happy drinking liquor and he alone knows about it, similarly the continuous flow of the elixir of Naam generates divine awareness that is indescribable.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਲਕ ਪੈ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਧਾਨ ਚਾਹੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਰੁਨਝੁਨ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੋਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: baalak pai naadh baadh sabadh bidhaan chaahai anahadh dhun runajhun surat srot hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a child is unable to explain the notes of music in various modes, similarly a Guru-conscious person who listens to the unstruck music cannot describe its sweetness and melody.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਾ ਮੈ ਬੀਤੈ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਜਿਉ ਤਰੋਵਰ ਨ ਗੋਤ ਹੈ ॥੧੭੨॥
verses.translit_en: akath kathaa binodh soiee jaanai jaa mai beetai cha(n)dhan suga(n)dh jiau tarovar na got hai ||172||

en.bdb: The melody of unstruck music and continuous fall of elixir as a result is beyond description. One who has the process going in his mind, experiences it. Just as the trees which are fragranced by a Sandalwood are not regarded different than the Sandalwood tree itself. (172)
